
```{devoirs_choices coefficient_9_one_choices}
- A conversion factor that turns an input quantity into units of the model output.:

- A probability distribution describing uncertainty in the output.:
    correct: false

      distribution.
- The input quantity that a model is trying to explain.:
    correct: false
    feedback: The input is a model variable; the coefficient is the multiplier applied
```
